authority: Web/backend database RPC; clients display server results and never infer confirmation eligibility, confirmer authority, cycle validity or evidence completion
scope: project plus person plus exact admission site confirmation before entry; D18 work eligibility is out of scope

confirmer.authority: current active role on the exact site_project

requirement.one_current: one current requirement per project and person
requirement.history: previous and successor requirements are linked and immutable evidence remains unchanged

prerequisites.employee: current D11 authoritative three-level status must be satisfied
prerequisites.admission_exam: current D13 exact admission/project/person/semantic/exam-plan submitted PASS attempt
prerequisites.special: current D12 authoritative special requirements must be satisfied
prerequisites.signature: D16 calls the authoritative D15 ensure operation; all applicable current required D15 signature requirements must be completed, and only an authoritative not_required result is not applicable
prerequisites.failure: fail closed without mutating D11, D12, D13 or D15 facts

photo.validation: private object is bounded, magic-checked, fully decoded and bound by actual SHA-256, size, dimensions, object id/version/update time and uploader

location.supplement: one immutable later location bound to the original requirement and result

time: confirmed_at is selected by the server and included in the final evidence digest

invalidation.project_reactivated: creates a new requirement for each current active non-visitor member with an exact admission
invalidation.membership_reactivated: creates a new requirement when the project is active
invalidation.future_events: authorized project manager or safety officer may invoke controlled supersede with source type, unique reference and reason

rpcs.name: training_site_confirmation_ensure
rpcs.authorization: current exact-project manager or safety officer

rpcs.name: training_site_confirmation_project_list
rpcs.authorization: current exact-project manager or safety officer

rpcs.name: training_site_confirmation_prepare
rpcs.authorization: current exact-project manager or safety officer

rpcs.name: d16-validate-site-photo edge handler
rpcs.authorization: current challenge confirmer JWT; service credential remains server-side

rpcs.name: training_site_confirmation_submit
rpcs.authorization: same current exact-project role revalidated at submit

rpcs.name: training_site_confirmation_supplement_location
rpcs.authorization: current exact-project manager or safety officer

rpcs.name: training_site_confirmation_supersede
rpcs.authorization: current exact-project manager or safety officer with audited source event and reason

idempotency.submit: requirement row lock plus one result per requirement plus signer/idempotency uniqueness
idempotency.concurrency: project-manager/safety-officer racing submissions converge on one authoritative result

boundary: D16 records site confirmation evidence only; it does not alter authoritative training, exam, signature, special-work or future D18 work-eligibility facts
